name: instance-derive-grants
title: tests(instance): derive write grant from create-only filesystem policy
body:
### What
Pins `derive_contract_grants`: a create-only filesystem policy derives the `filesystem.**` write grant while read stays ungranted.

### Why it matters
Create implies mutation; dropping the create arm or requiring both lists silently unmediates creation paths. Existing recipes always set read+write+create together, so the create-only edge is unpinned.

### Mutation evidence (fail-then-pass)
| Mutant | Existing suite | New test |
|---|---|---|
| drop `|| !filesystem_create...is_empty()` | PASS (survives) | FAIL (killed) |
| `||` -> `&&` | PASS (survives) | FAIL (killed) |

Baseline: PASS. Reproduce: `cargo test -p ginux-instance --lib create_only_filesystem_grants`.

Prepared with AI assistance; reviewed by me.

name: instance-validate-identifier
title: tests(instance): pin id and hostname identifier validation edges
body:
### What
Pins `validate` identifier rules for both id and hostname: empty/spaced rejected, dotted alnum accepted, hostname checked independently.

### Why it matters
Hostname defaults to id, so suites that never set a distinct hostname cannot detect a skipped hostname check. Removing either validation call survives today.

### Mutation evidence (fail-then-pass)
| Mutant | Existing suite | New test |
|---|---|---|
| skip `validate_identifier(self.id...)` | PASS (survives) | FAIL (killed) |
| skip `validate_identifier(self.hostname...)` | PASS (survives) | FAIL (killed) |

Baseline: PASS. Reproduce: `cargo test -p ginux-instance --lib validate_pins_identifier`.

Prepared with AI assistance; reviewed by me.

name: instance-override-id
title: tests(instance): pin instance.id override and unknown-key rejection
body:
### What
Pins the `instance.id` override arm: quoted values apply, unknown keys and unquoted values fail closed without partial mutation.

### Why it matters
Deleting the arm or making it a no-op silently ignores operator overrides; existing tests pin vcpus/hostname but not id.

### Mutation evidence (fail-then-pass)
| Mutant | Existing suite | New test |
|---|---|---|
| delete `instance.id` arm | PASS (survives) | FAIL (killed) |
| arm parses but discards value | PASS (survives) | FAIL (killed) |

Baseline: PASS. Reproduce: `cargo test -p ginux-instance --lib override_instance_id`.

name: instance-override-resources
title: tests(instance): pin memory override application and exact bounds
body:
### What
Pins the `resources.memory_mib` override: value applies, exact lower bound 16 accepted, 15 rejected atomically, quoted numbers rejected.

### Why it matters
Override arms are fail-closed config gates; deleting the memory arm or its validation admits invalid configs. Existing override tests pin vcpus but never memory.

### Mutation evidence (fail-then-pass)
| Mutant | Existing suite | New test |
|---|---|---|
| delete `resources.memory_mib` arm | PASS (survives) | FAIL (killed) |
| discard parsed u64 (return Ok(256)) | PASS (survives) | FAIL (killed) |

Baseline: PASS. Reproduce: `cargo test -p ginux-instance --lib memory_override_enforces`.

name: process-pipe-ends-guards
title: tests(process): pin pipe_ends zero for invalid and dead pipes

mutants.name: oob-index

body:
### What
Pins `pipe_ends`: pipe 0 and out-of-range ids report 0, live pipes report their end count, freed slots report 0, reused slots report fresh counts.

### Why it matters
Diagnostics drive leak checks; dropping the zero guard indexes pipe 0 - 1 (underflow) and returning 0 for live pipes misreports leaks. No existing test exercises these edges.

### Mutation evidence (fail-then-pass)
| Mutant | Existing suite | New test |
|---|---|---|
| disable `pipe == 0` guard | PASS (survives) | FAIL (killed) |
| return 0 for live pipes | PASS (survives) | FAIL (killed) |

Baseline: PASS. Reproduce: `cargo test -p ginux-process --lib pipe_ends_reports`.

Prepared with AI assistance; reviewed by me.

name: process-unshare-copy
title: tests(process): pin unshare private-copy, solo no-op, and unknown-task edges
body:
### What
Pins `unshare`: a shared descriptor table is copied privately (pipe ends retained), a solo task is a no-op, and unknown tasks return Ok without allocation.

### Why it matters
Exec unshares files before CLOEXEC scrub; counting zero members or off-by-one on the member threshold either leaks shared fds across exec or double-retains pipes. No existing test exercises unshare.

### Mutation evidence (fail-then-pass)
| Mutant | Existing suite | New test |
|---|---|---|
| `**member != 0` -> `== 0` | PASS (survives) | FAIL (killed) |
| `> 1` -> `>= 1` | PASS (survives) | FAIL (killed) |

Baseline: PASS. Reproduce: `cargo test -p ginux-process --lib unshare_copies_shared`.

Prepared with AI assistance; reviewed by me.

name: kernel-views-cgroup-remove-busy
title: tests(kernel-views): pin cgroup remove busy guard for active children
body:
### What
Pins `remove` busy semantics: an active child group blocks parent removal, leaf groups remove cleanly, freed inactive slots never block, root and non-root callers are denied.

### Why it matters
The busy guard chains `active && path != self && parent == path`; flipping any operator lets parents of live children be removed (orphaning confinement) or blocks legitimate cleanup. Existing tests pin only the member-count branch.

### Mutation evidence (fail-then-pass)
| Mutant | Existing suite | New test |
|---|---|---|
| `group.active &&` -> `group.active ||` | PASS (survives) | FAIL (killed) |
| `parent_path(...) == path` -> `!= path` | PASS (survives) | FAIL (killed) |

Baseline: PASS. Reproduce: `cargo test -p ginux-kernel-views --lib remove_busy_only`.

Prepared with AI assistance; reviewed by me.

name: instance-override-arms-table
title: tests(instance): pin override arms for workdir, environment, selective, catalog
body:
### What
Table-driven pin of four `apply_override_inner` arms (workdir, environment, syscalls.control=selective, catalog): values apply, unknown and derived keys fail closed.

### Why it matters
Each match arm is an operator-facing config gate; deleting any arm silently ignores overrides. Existing tests cover id/vcpus/hostname but not these four arms.

### Mutation evidence (fail-then-pass)
| Mutant | Existing suite | New test |
|---|---|---|
| delete `instance.workdir` arm | PASS (survives) | FAIL (killed) |
| delete `instance.environment` arm | PASS (survives) | FAIL (killed) |
| delete `b"selective"` arm | PASS (survives) | FAIL (killed) |
| delete `contract.catalog` arm | PASS (survives) | FAIL (killed) |

Baseline: PASS. Reproduce: `cargo test -p ginux-instance --lib override_arms_apply`.
